cover_letter.greeting: Dear Amazon Devices Sales and Marketing Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Finance Analyst role on the Devices Sales and Marketing Finance team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I spent about five and a half years at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Marketing finance is the part of finance I know best, so a team that funds and measures Devices marketing is a natural fit.

At JPMorgan I built models on $10M of marketing-channel budget, quantifying ROI across scenarios, and benchmarked past channel allocations against peers, which pointed to 30% efficiency gains. At Lenovo I built forecast models and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and ran variance analyses on budget reallocation.
That maps to planning marketing spend, tracking returns and explaining variances to the business. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team's priorities.
